chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 297 – Han Li’s Cold Infiltration & the Mind Control Art’s Hidden Power
chapter_meta_description: Han Li ghosts through a Prince’s manor, weaponizing a “useless” Foundation Establishment spell to extract critical intel without a single fight. A masterclass in Mortal Stream social tribulation.
og_title: Infiltration – Han Li’s Cold Eye on the Prince’s Manor
og_description: No fireballs, no bloodshed—just a silenced maid, a hidden technique, and a personality flip that screams trouble.
twitter_description: Han Li turns a "chicken rib" spell into his deadliest weapon yet—a silent, surgical strike in the heart of enemy territory.

lore_anchors.definition: A Foundation Establishment spell that can enslave a mortal's will, but is considered a "chicken rib" technique because it is useless against cultivators and requires abnormally strong divine sense to practice.
A Foundation Establishment utility technique that withdraws the cultivator's spiritual aura, making them appear as a mortal to anyone of a lower cultivation level.

The second major cultivation realm; marks a cultivator who has stabilized their internal foundation, granting significantly longer lifespan and the ability to use mid-grade techniques and magical tools.
